text: Nikita wants to compare her carbon footprint for air travel and train travel.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
She finds that the personal carbon footprint, C, for train travel is 40 g/km for each passenger for
any length of journey.
Sketch the graph of the model for C for train travel on the axes in Question 10(b)(ii).

parts.text:
One train company claims:
When you travel by train, your carbon footprint will never be more than 30% of your
carbon footprint for the same journey by air.
For what lengths of journey is this claim correct?
